title: Spain's Estopa release new album La Maketa next week ahead of a stadium tour
summary: The duo will play four stadium shows in Spain in summer 2027.
body:
Spanish duo Estopa release their new album, La Maketa, on Friday 20 November.

The record goes back to the brothers' earliest songs, including some that were never released, according to Spanish media.

Four stadium dates

The album will be followed by a stadium tour of Spain in summer 2027:

  • Valencia, Estadio Ciutat de València: 12 June
  • Barcelona, Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys: 18 June
  • Seville, Estadio La Cartuja: 26 June
  • Madrid, Riyadh Air Metropolitano: 9 July

Estopa, formed by brothers David and José Muñoz, are one of the best-selling Spanish groups of the past 25 years.

Sources: elDiario.es, Telecinco.
